Who we are

This Privacy Policy explains how AM (trading as AM, “we”, “us”) handles personal information collected through this website. We are a digital marketing agency based in Pakistan.

For privacy questions or requests, email privacy@am.example.

LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED: Confirm the legal entity name, registration type and the person or role responsible for privacy matters. Add registered details only once they are real and verified.

Information we collect

We collect only what we need to respond to you and to run this website.

Information you give us

  • Contact form: full name, business email address, company name, service of interest and project details. Phone number, website address and budget range are optional.
  • Emails, calls and messages you send us directly, including anything you choose to include in them.

Information collected automatically

  • Basic technical information that web servers receive when you visit any website, such as IP address, browser type, pages requested and time of request. These server logs are handled by our hosting provider for security and reliability.
  • This website does not use analytics, advertising pixels or tracking cookies at the time of writing. See our Cookie Policy.

Information we ask you not to send

Please do not send national identity card (CNIC) numbers, passport numbers, passwords, payment card details or other sensitive personal information through the contact form or by email. We do not need them to respond to an inquiry.

Why we use your information and our legal basis

  • To respond to your inquiry and prepare a proposal, which is a step you ask us to take before entering a contract.
  • To communicate with you about the services you have asked about.
  • To keep this website and our systems secure and working.
  • To meet legal and accounting obligations if you become a client.

We rely on your consent where you tick the consent box on the contact form. You may withdraw it at any time (see “Your rights”). We do not use your inquiry details for unrelated marketing without a separate, clear choice from you. We do not sell personal information.

LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED: The lawful bases available depend on the laws that apply to you and to us. A lawyer should confirm which bases to state for Pakistan, India and any other regions served.

Data minimisation

We ask only for the details needed to understand and answer your inquiry. Fields that are not essential are marked optional. We do not collect CNIC or passport numbers, payment card details, passwords or sensitive personal data through this website.

How long we keep information

We keep inquiry details only for as long as needed to respond and, if no engagement follows, for a limited period afterwards in case you contact us again. If you become a client, we keep records for as long as needed to deliver services and meet legal, tax and accounting requirements. We delete or anonymise information we no longer need.

LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED: Insert the actual retention periods the business will follow (for example, a fixed number of months for unsuccessful inquiries) and confirm any minimum record-keeping periods under Pakistani tax and company law.

Security

We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal information, including encrypted connections (HTTPS), restricted access to inquiry data and the use of reputable service providers. No system is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security. If we become aware of a security incident affecting your personal information, we will take appropriate steps, including notifying you or authorities where the law requires it.

Service providers and third parties

We may share personal information with service providers who help us run the website and handle inquiries, only to the extent needed for those services and under appropriate terms. These may include website hosting, form processing, email, calendar scheduling and customer-relationship-management providers. We do not allow them to use your information for their own marketing.

We may also disclose information where required by law or to protect our legal rights.

NEEDS CONFIGURATION / LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED: List the actual providers used at launch (hosting, form handler, email, CRM, calendar) and what each receives. The demo form is not connected to any provider yet. Confirm data-processing terms and where each provider stores data.

Analytics and advertising

At the time of writing, this website does not use Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, heatmaps or other advertising or analytics tools. If we add any, we will update this policy and our Cookie Policy and, where required, ask for your consent before they run.

Cookies

See our Cookie Policy for details of the cookies and similar storage used on this website and how to manage your preferences.

Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to:

  • ask whether we hold personal information about you and request a copy;
  • ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete information;
  • ask us to delete your information;
  • withdraw consent you have given, at any time, without affecting what we did before you withdrew;
  • object to or ask us to limit certain uses; and
  • complain to a regulator or, where applicable, use our grievance contact below.

To exercise a right, email privacy@am.example from the address you used with us so we can verify your request. We will respond within a reasonable time.

LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED: State the response time the business can honour and confirm which rights apply under the laws relevant to your users.

Deleting your information

You can ask us to delete your personal information at any time by emailing privacy@am.example. We will delete it unless we must keep it for a legal reason, in which case we will tell you what we are keeping and why. Information held by our service providers will be deleted according to their processes.

International transfers

We are based in Pakistan. Some service providers may store or process information in other countries. Where we transfer personal information across borders, we intend to use providers that protect it appropriately.

LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED: Confirm where each provider stores data, whether any restrictions on cross-border transfers apply under Pakistani or Indian law, and whether contractual safeguards are needed.

Children

Our services are for businesses and are not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 18. If you believe a child has sent us information, please contact us and we will delete it.

Pakistan legal context

We aim to handle personal information responsibly and in line with laws that apply to us in Pakistan.

LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED: Pakistan has had a long-running effort to adopt a dedicated personal data protection law, and its status, scope and any regulator or registration requirements must be checked on the date of launch. Other laws and sector rules (for example on electronic transactions, cybercrime and consumer protection, and obligations that depend on business structure) may also apply. We have not listed specific legal duties here because they must be confirmed by a Pakistani lawyer. Do not state that the business is compliant with any specific law until that review is complete.

Users in India (Digital Personal Data Protection Act)

If you are in India, we aim to give you a clear notice of what we collect and why, to ask for your consent through an unticked consent box, to let you withdraw consent as easily as you gave it, to collect only what is needed, and to give you a way to raise concerns (see “Contact and grievances”). We do not knowingly process the personal data of children.

LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED: India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and its Rules may apply when personal data of people in India is processed in connection with offering services to them. A qualified lawyer should check the current status of the Rules and decide on: the wording and language of the notice (including availability in Indian languages where required), consent records, retention and erasure, children's data, cross-border transfer conditions, appointing any required contact or officer, breach notification, and whether any obligations beyond this notice apply. This page does not claim DPDP compliance.

Contact and grievances

For questions, requests or complaints about how we handle personal information, email privacy@am.example. We will acknowledge your message and respond within a reasonable time. If you are not satisfied, you may also contact the relevant data-protection authority in your country where one exists.

NEEDS CONFIGURATION: Name the person or role responsible for privacy and grievance handling and add a monitored mailbox. Replace the demonstration address with a real one.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy as our services or the law change. The date at the top shows when it was last revised. Material changes will be highlighted on this page. Last updated: 7 October 2026.
